sample: 仅商品2016-01-01至2021-12-31。组件与前一版组合研究期结果已看过，因此本组合是事后探索，不作确认性结论。不读取2022及2023年以后。

inputs.carry: RQData roll_yield main_sub annualized_yield, lagged one trading day; use sign only and do not label positive/negative as backwardation/contango without validating vendor formula
inputs.clock: full-trading-day ts_low - ts_high from all available bars, including NIGHT, normalized across all bars

rules.direction: trend sign must be nonzero and equal lagged carry sign; clock tail must have the same sign
rules.risk_scale: cross-sectional pool median ATR% / own ATR%, clipped to [0.5, 2.0]
rules.entry: next tradable open after close signal
rules.costs: historical fee cache and prior-year estimated tick

prior_information: The day-session, cross-sectional, positive-carry component backtests and the earlier day-session combined candidate results were viewed before this variant.
